transcript: I have severe crushing chest pain, feels like an elephant is sitting on my chest, and the pain is radiating down my left arm and I'm drenched in cold sweats.
description: Classic acute STEMI / ACS presentation with left arm radiation and diaphoresis

transcript: Terrible pressure in the center of my chest radiating to my jaw, I feel nauseous and dizzy with clammy skin.
description: Female atypical ACS with jaw radiation and autonomic symptoms

transcript: Severe squeezing chest tightness that started 20 minutes ago while walking up stairs. Both arms feel heavy and aching.
description: Exertional acute angina / unstable ACS with bilateral arm pain

transcript: I have sudden crushing substernal chest pressure, difficulty catching my breath, and sudden sweating profusely.
description: Acute myocardial ischemia with dyspnea and diaphoresis

transcript: Sudden onset of chest pain radiating to neck and jaw with cold sweats and feeling like fainting.
description: Acute coronary event with presyncope and radiation

transcript: My mother's face is drooping on the right side and when she tries to talk her speech is completely slurred.
description: Classic BE-FAST acute ischemic stroke with facial droop and dysarthria

transcript: Suddenly I cannot lift my left arm at all, it feels numb and heavy, and I have trouble speaking properly.
description: Acute hemiparesis and expressive aphasia within thrombolytic window

transcript: Woke up with crooked smile, arm weakness on the right side, and sudden confusion.
description: Wake-up stroke with facial asymmetry, weakness, and disorientation

transcript: I just experienced the worst headache of my entire life, it hit like an explosive thunderclap in under a minute.
description: Thunderclap headache indicating Subarachnoid Hemorrhage (SAH)

transcript: My husband suddenly cannot find words, his speech slurred and his right mouth is drooping.
description: Acute stroke symptom triad reported by bystander

transcript: Ate something with peanuts 10 minutes ago, now my throat is closing up and my tongue is swelling, having severe trouble breathing.
description: Severe IgE-mediated anaphylaxis with acute airway obstruction risk

transcript: Stung by a wasp, lips swelling rapidly, throat tightness and high pitched stridor sound when I inhale.
description: Hymenoptera venom anaphylaxis with stridor

transcript: Severe asthma attack, inhaler isn't working, I cannot speak full sentences and gasping for air.
description: Status asthmaticus with impending respiratory exhaustion

transcript: Cannot breathe at all, gasping for air, and my wife says my lips are turning blue.
description: Severe acute hypoxemic respiratory failure with central cyanosis

transcript: Choking sound and stridor after swallowing food, struggling to get air in.
description: Acute upper foreign body airway obstruction

transcript: My 2 year old toddler has a burning high fever of 104 and is completely lethargic, won't wake up and limp.
description: Pediatric septic shock / meningitis risk with lethargy and extreme pyrexia

transcript: My 6 weeks old newborn baby has a 103 fever and inconsolable crying, refusing all feeds.
description: Neonatal fever (<90 days) requiring immediate sepsis protocol

transcript: My 4 year old son has a 104 fever and unusually sleepy, cannot wake him to drink fluids.
description: Pediatric fever with altered sensorium

transcript: Excruciating stomach pain that started around my navel and moved to the lower right belly, high fever, cannot stand straight.
description: Acute appendicitis with localized peritonism

transcript: Excruciating severe stomach pain and my stomach is hard as a rock, like a board, vomiting blood.
description: Perforated viscus / acute peritonitis with hematemesis

transcript: Severe abdominal pain with continuous vomiting blood and black tarry stools.
description: Acute upper gastrointestinal hemorrhage with hemodynamic risk

transcript: I have isolated chest pain that is sharp when I breathe in, no radiation to arm, no sweating, no dizziness.
description: Pleuritic chest pain without ACS red-flags requiring ECG evaluation

transcript: My heart feels like it is racing and fluttering in my chest for the past hour, but no chest pressure and no shortness of breath.
description: Isolated palpitations / SVT risk needing urgent ECG

transcript: High fever of 103 with chills and body aches, no confusion, no neck stiffness, able to drink water.
description: High fever in adult without altered sensorium requiring diagnostic workup

transcript: Right lower quadrant belly pain for 6 hours, feels like appendix, mild nausea.
description: Suspected early appendicitis needing urgent surgical consult

transcript: I have had a mild cough, runny nose, and sneezing for 3 days. No fever, no shortness of breath.
description: Uncomplicated upper respiratory infection (common cold)

transcript: Mild itchy spot on my forearm that looks like dry eczema. No fever, no swelling, no pain.
description: Localized non-spreading dermatitis

transcript: Twisted ankle while playing basketball yesterday, mild sprain, able to bear weight, no visible deformity.
description: Low-grade ankle sprain suitable for RICE protocol

transcript: I am feeling fine, just calling to renew my blood pressure medication prescription refill before traveling.
description: Pure administrative medication refill

transcript: Scratchy throat and slight nasal congestion for two days, no fever, no difficulty swallowing.
description: Mild pharyngitis / seasonal allergies

transcript: Need a routine checkup and blood pressure check, no acute complaints today.
description: Routine wellness follow-up

transcript: I have a mild runny nose and cough. I have NO chest pain, NOT having trouble breathing, and denies any dizziness.
description: Negation handling - patient explicitly denies chest pain and dyspnea

transcript: Doctor asked if my face was drooping or if I had slurred speech, but I have NEVER had facial droop or arm weakness. Just mild dermatitis rash on leg.
description: Negation handling - patient denies stroke features while discussing rash

transcript: I feel an elephant on my chest and severe pain down my left arm, probably just acid reflux or indigestion though.
description: Patient minimizes symptoms (believes it is indigestion) - Arbiter MUST override

transcript: My left face is drooping and speech is garbled, I think I'm just tired and want to sleep it off.
description: Patient plans to sleep off stroke - Arbiter MUST override and escalate
